name: 复诊沟通
description: 你复诊时需要向医生反馈恢复情况，讨论是否需要调整治疗方案。
setting: A doctor's office during a follow-up visit. You are discussing your recovery.

objectives.description: 反馈用药效果和副作用

acts.name: 主线
goal: Introduce organic twists or complications to keep the conversation natural.

A1.twist: The doctor asks simple yes/no questions.

acts.name: 开场
acts.goal: Greet and say you feel better.

B1.setting: A follow-up visit. The medicine causes mild side effects.
B1.twist: You are unsure whether to keep taking the medicine.

acts.name: 主线
acts.goal: Explain side effects and ask for advice.

B2.setting: A follow-up after surgery. Your recovery is slower than expected.

acts.goal: Question the treatment options and risks.
